=== just setup/build artifacts ===
OK  bin/green-ecolution
OK  frontend/app/dist/index.html
OK  frontend/app/public/handbook/green-ecolution-handbuch.pdf
OK  frontend/packages/domain-wasm/pkg/domain_wasm_bg.wasm
OK  frontend/keycloak-theme/dist_keycloak/keycloak-theme.jar

=== http endpoints ===
http://localhost:3000/                                  200
http://localhost:3000/api/health                        200
http://localhost:3000/api-docs/openapi.json             200

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== just setup/build artifacts ==="; for f in bin/green-ecolution frontend/app/dist/index.html frontend/app/public/handbook/green-ecolution-handbuch.pdf frontend/packages/domain-wasm/pkg/domain_wasm_bg.wasm frontend/keycloak-theme/dist_keycloak/keycloak-theme.jar; do [ -e "$f" ] && echo "OK  $f" || echo "MISSING  $f"; done; echo; echo "=== http endpoints ==="; for u in "http://localhost:3000/" "http://localhost:3000/api/health" "http://localhost:3000/api-docs/openapi.json"; do printf "%-55s %s\n" "$u" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$u" --max-time 10)"; done
